reference.title: Scenario: topicmeta in practice
reference.shortdesc: <topicmeta> is used inside a <topicref> to override or enhance the way a topic appears

section.p: <topicmeta> is used inside a <topicref> to override or enhance the way a topic appears in navigation and output, without changing the original topic file. The <navtitle> controls the label shown in the table of contents, while the <shortdesc> provides a brief description that may appear in summaries, search results, or tooltips.
section.codeblock: <map> <topicref href="c_security_overview.dita"> <topicmeta> <navtitle>Security Basics</navtitle> <shortdesc>Learn the fundamentals of application security.</shortdesc> </topicmeta> </topicref> </map>
